name: TurboBid Electrical
summary: Electrical estimating sold as a one-time purchase or a subscription, with a separate cloud service for price updates.
differentiator: Publishes both the one-time price and the monthly price of the cloud service that carries material price updates, so a real yearly cost can be worked out from its own pages.
pricing: $1,395 one-time (list price $1,620, sale price shown the day we read it). TurboCloud, the sync service, is listed at $99 a month with the first month free on purchase; a one-year plan averages $79 a month. A monthly software subscription is also offered. We did not read its price.

scope.takeoff: On-screen takeoff is listed among its features.
scope.library: Items and assemblies with an assembly editor. Counts are not stated.
scope.laborUnits: A labor unit feature and an employee labor burden wizard. The source of units is not stated.

materialPrices.note: Updates come through TurboCloud ($99 a month), TurboPrice or NetPricer connections, or supply house update files.

bestFor: Shops that want to own the software and price the update service separately.
skipIf: You want one monthly price that includes everything.
watchOut: The sale price may change. Confirm it on the vendor page.
TurboBid's own pages do not state a labor-unit source or an assembly count.
